question: What ongoing practice sustains the assembly of yoginis at all times?
premises: One should partake of that substance.
This should be done at all times.
The assembly of yoginis may then occur.
inference: By always partaking of that, the assembly of yoginis may take place.
uncertainties: The referent of tat is context-dependent.
plain_english: One should always partake of that, so that the assembly of yoginis may occur.
